pairedMatcher: Unchanged current 0.63 matcher, same version in both arms
exposure: Each model receives its frozen existing question exposure; identical question IDs in the two executor arms. No outcome-driven invitations. Research mapping/rule changes measured separately.
blindness: Grok receives profile facts and actual multiple-choice prompts only. Prior answers, outcome counts, career links, scoring rules, route and wage metadata are withheld. Occupation names naturally contained within an assessment item are retained.
unknowns: No unstated interest invented; unfamiliar means unknown, not rejection. Skills, caregiving duties, demographic and wellbeing characteristics do not establish enjoyment.
limits: AI response-executor agreement study; neither executor is a ground-truth student response. Fixed comprehensive exposure is not real survey completion.
